notes: 火柴头不再含易燃物、改由火柴盒侧面的红磷擦纸点燃的「安全火柴」，由瑞典人帕施 1844 年提出（专利用于擦面）；伦德斯特伦兄弟在延雪平量产，1855 年在巴黎世博会展出。更早的中国硫磺松木条据元代《南村辍耕录》（1366）记载，577 年已有人使用。
summary_zh: 1826 年斯托克顿药剂师约翰·沃克发明摩擦火柴；今天常用的安全火柴把红磷放到火柴盒侧面，由瑞典人发展并在延雪平量产。
summary_en: Stockton chemist John Walker invented the friction match in 1826. Today's safety match moves red phosphorus to the box's striker, an idea developed and mass-produced in Sweden.

image.alt_zh: 在火柴盒上划燃一根火柴
image.alt_en: Striking a match on its box

notes_en: The safety match puts red phosphorus on the box's striker instead of in the head; Swede Gustaf Erik Pasch proposed it in 1844 and patented the striking surface. The Lundström brothers mass-produced it in Jönköping and showed it at the 1855 Paris Exhibition. Chinese sulfur-impregnated pine sticks are said, in a 1366 text, to have been used as early as 577.
